STYLE: Vertical 9:16 cinematic documentary still, photorealistic. Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF with Cooke S4 32mm, f/2.0, ISO 800, 1/50s, 180-degree shutter. Moody, slightly desaturated grade with deep shadows and warm practical highlights, fine 35mm film grain, light vignette. Not a stock image, not an AI render, no text overlays, no watermark, no logos. Any book, sign, screen or packaging text in the background is out of focus and unreadable unless described.
SKIN: visible pores, micro-texture, natural skin imperfections, subtle peach fuzz, natural skin sheen, no airbushing, no smoothing filters
